W: one storey band of glazing, the two-light window, the glazed red double door and the single light (3 openings, 3 axes) under a level eaves; the frieze vents are not glazing. S gable: two three-light windows, two small four-pane windows high in the gable (2, 2), symmetric, one gable peak.

facades.name: W front on the square
facades.note: Recount under the ribbon convention after the first compare: the two-light window (t 4.98-6.46), the glazed red double door (6.48-7.85) and the single light (7.87-8.6) stand frame to frame under the one name board; only the door's meeting stiles (about 0.35 m of red between its two tall lights) are wider than 0.3 m, so the photo shows two glazed runs, window + left leaf and right leaf + single light (the first count of 3 counted the parts).
